The discussion centered on issues with the nightly recalculation process. [p1] noted that the night recalc for each facility performed two calculations: one for a broken category and another for Transport Hub. However, there was no prediction calculation for deactivated facilities included in the pluses.

Later, [me] confirmed the delivery of several test models located in S3, which were requested by [p1].
decisions: The night recalc process needs further review.
